name: sweep
description: Audit macOS storage and reclaim durable space with explicit safety gates

interface.shortDescription: Audit first; reclaim durable space safely.
interface.longDescription: Sweep audits macOS storage, separates durable recovery from temporary cache relief, and cleans only exact targets approved after project, simulator, Photos, and active-process safety checks.
defaultPrompt: Use $sweep:cleanup to audit my Mac storage safely before proposing any cleanup.
Use $sweep:cleanup to inspect Xcode and simulator storage without deleting anything.
Use $sweep:cleanup to make a safe plan for reaching a specific free-space target.
